# Controlled Fixture

`invoice_textract.json` is a hand-authored, synthetic Textract response used only to test field normalization, confidence, and source-location handling. It is not output from an OCR run or evidence of extraction accuracy.

`controlled_invoice.html` and `controlled_invoice.png` are generated, non-sensitive test evidence. The PNG is used by the browser upload test and for a separately recorded one-page Textract service check. Every supplier, account, invoice number, and amount is fictional; the image is explicitly marked as test evidence and not payable.
